name: Vercel
description: Vercel describes itself as an "agentic infrastructure" cloud platform for deploying apps, AI agents, and autonomous systems at scale, connecting a Git repository to deploy on every push with automatic preview environments.
best_for: Targets developers building AI applications and autonomous agents, teams deploying web apps and marketing sites, platform builders serving multiple customers, and enterprises needing secure, scalable infrastructure.
features: Git-connected deploys with automatic preview environments
AI Gateway (access to hundreds of AI models via one endpoint)
Sandbox (secure ephemeral execution for untrusted code)
Fluid Compute Functions for API routes
Configurable WAF and Bot Management/BotID security
Global Vercel Delivery Network with instant scaling

alternatives.name: Netlify
alternatives.description: A platform to create with AI or code and deploy instantly on production infrastructure.
alternatives.best_for: Product engineers, AI developers, marketers, and designers building web apps.

alternatives.name: Docker
alternatives.description: A platform for building, shipping, and running containerized applications.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and enterprises standardizing application packaging/deployment via containers.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Includes $20 usage credit; additional usage can apply.

cons: Pro is not a fixed all-inclusive $20 bill: it includes usage credit and metered usage can add cost.
Enterprise pricing is not public and requires contacting sales.
